name: Prasun Kumar
headline: AI/ML Engineering | GenAI & Agentic AI | Solution Architecture & Technical Leadership
summary: AI/ML engineer with 9+ years of software-engineering experience and prior technical leadership at Harbinger Group. Builds enterprise GenAI, RAG, agent workflows, document intelligence and NLP/ML solutions using Python, Azure OpenAI and cloud-native services. Combines hands-on engineering with architecture reviews, mentoring, delivery planning and stakeholder coordination. Focuses on evaluation, human review, reliability, security and production readiness. Currently Senior Application Developer at IBM India, having joined on 3 November 2026.
